scope: Stable MATLAB-like v1.0 target subset; not complete MATLAB compatibility

features.feature: Lossless tokens, trivia, identifiers, numbers, text literals, keywords, and operators
features.limits: Single and double quoted literals preserve distinct character-array and string-array runtime kinds; command-form syntax is outside the target subset.

features.feature: Expression precedence with delayed call/index and member resolution
features.limits: Production method/object dispatch and anonymous closures are supported through the bytecode VM. Anonymous-function text parsing, computed-string lazy source loading, and the remaining MATLAB call/index shadowing edge cases remain open.

features.feature: for, parfor-as-serial, while, if, switch, try/catch, break, continue, return
features.limits: parfor executes serially; typed regions accept only structured eligible control flow; no finally construct exists in MATLAB or MParser.

features.feature: Local functions, positional/repeating/name-value arguments, nargin/nargout, and multiple outputs
features.limits: The C ABI 1.1, C++ source API 1.0, machine protocol 1.0, and builtin source contract 1.0 are frozen candidates. An arbitrary external native callback or plugin ABI is Post-v1.0.

features.feature: Cross-file source loading, paths, packages, private functions, and class folders
features.limits: MATLAB path precedence and shadowing are implemented for the declared subset, not every toolbox or built-in precedence case.

features.feature: Dense double/logical scalar, vector, matrix, and N-dimensional shape/index semantics
features.limits: Complex, sparse, integer-width, categorical, table, and GPU numeric storage classes are not represented. Object arrays use the separate CLASS-006 contract.

features.feature: Logical indexing, colon/end indexing, indexed growth, and deletion
features.limits: Typed/native coverage is narrower than VM correctness and falls back under guards.

features.feature: Distinct UTF-16 character arrays and string arrays with shared shape, indexing, mutation, conversion, and formatting contracts
features.limits: v0.75 covers quote/empty distinctions, UTF-8 boundaries, UTF-16 code-unit lengths, parenthesis and string-brace indexing, assignment/growth/deletion, concatenation, implicit expansion, transpose and array transforms, representative conversions and predicates, missing strings, class properties, and CLI formatting. Unicode normalization and non-ASCII case folding, complete text function families, tables/categorical values, and typed/native lowering remain open.

features.feature: N-dimensional Cell construction, scalar brace reads/writes, varargin, and varargout-like values
features.limits: v0.72 adds shared parenthesis indexing, assignment, common growth, linear vector deletion, brace content selection, and nested copy-back. Direct multi-output brace lowering and complete comma-separated-list contexts remain open.

features.feature: Ordered scalar structures, static/dynamic fields, fieldnames, isfield, rmfield, and isstruct
features.limits: Scalar structures use the same canonical element/schema representation as structure arrays; v0.72 routes nested structure mutation through the shared lvalue transaction.

features.feature: Structure arrays and comma-separated field lists
features.limits: v0.71 established array storage and field lists; v0.72 adds nested S(index).field copy-back, indexed intermediate growth, and schema extension. Bulk field assignment through nonscalar intermediates and general N-dimensional deletion remain open.

features.feature: Transactional root-and-path lvalues across member, parenthesis, and brace segments
features.limits: Intermediate selections must resolve to one value; HIR does not execute classdef objects; object setters and handle aliases retain their documented side effects; typed/native tiers fall back to the VM.

features.feature: Scoped global and per-function persistent bindings with reusable runtime sessions
features.limits: v0.78 requires declarations before use, initializes first declarations as 0-by-0 doubles, keys persistent variables by compiled callable identity plus canonical function identity, and routes all supported writes through RuntimeSessionState. Different modules may share globals without colliding same-named persistent functions. No-argument clear preserves shared state; MATLAB command forms for clearing names, globals, or functions remain unsupported. Individual state operations are mutex-protected, but callers must serialize compound invocation on one shared state. Typed/native regions fall back to the VM.

features.feature: Canonical RuntimeValue ownership, shape, workspace, call-frame, and structured fallback contracts
features.limits: v0.79 freezes the internal source contract needed by the builtin registry: explicit ownership classes, storable transport boundaries, normalized shape/payload invariants, value-copy versus handle-alias behavior, function-handle identity/context lifetime, shared call-frame arity, and machine-readable fallback categories. v0.90 separately freezes its C ABI, C++ source API, and machine projection; internal C++ layout, garbage collection, and MATLAB type completeness are not public promises.

features.feature: Deterministic validation of internal bytecode before VM, optimization, or typed execution
features.limits: BytecodeProgram is an internal in-memory representation, not a public serialization or ABI. Direct untrusted entries validate on every call; CompiledModule and AdaptiveBytecodeVmSession paths own immutable snapshots and validate once before explicit trusted internal execution. Typed modules are installed only when each contract exactly matches the contract re-derived from validated bytecode.

features.feature: MException stack/cause/report contracts, throw policies, warning/lastwarn, assert, and embedding-visible diagnostics
features.limits: v0.73 exposes complete N-by-1 file/name/line stacks across the source graph, recursive causes, basic/extended reports, throwAsCaller, severity-tagged warnings, lastwarn, and assert. Correction is an explicit Missing placeholder and addCorrection reports MParser:UnsupportedExceptionCorrection; warning state resets for each runtime invocation, report text is MParser-defined, and typed/native tiers fall back to the VM.

features.feature: Named, anonymous, method, and built-in function handles with dynamic invocation
features.limits: v0.74 supports named, anonymous, and builtin handles in both baseline engines; method handles remain bytecode-only. feval, str2func, func2str, functions metadata, closure snapshots, same-CompiledModule persistence, and deterministic variable/path/package/private/builtin shadowing are covered. Anonymous text parsing, computed-string lazy source loading, serialization, and a cross-process handle ABI remain unsupported.

features.feature: classdef declarations, attributes, properties, methods, events, enumeration, arguments, and inheritance syntax
features.limits: The matrix declares supported attributes explicitly; undocumented attributes and every MATLAB metaclass edge are not implied.

features.feature: Value/handle construction, inheritance, superclass calls, access policy, and method dispatch
features.limits: v0.76 adds value, handle, and matlab.mixin.Heterogeneous arrays. Mixins beyond the declared subset, getDefaultScalarElement/convertObject hooks, ordinary class-dominance conversion, and every MATLAB constructor-order edge remain open.

features.feature: Validated, dependent, constant, abstract, observable, and accessor-backed properties
features.limits: v0.76 adds logical-order property comma-separated lists, whole-array method receivers, and indexed scalar value/handle copy-back. MATLAB-style direct nonscalar property assignment is rejected; general comma-separated assignment distribution and every MATLAB validation conversion class are not complete.

features.feature: Events, listeners, dynamic properties, explicit handle deletion, and validity
features.limits: v0.76 applies explicit delete and isvalid elementwise to handle arrays and skips repeated aliases. Automatic reachability destruction, cyclic collection, nonscalar event registration/notification, and every event-data subclass behavior remain open.

features.feature: Class, member, function, call-signature, argument, validation, namespace, and dynamic-property metadata queries
features.limits: v0.77 freezes the supported metadata graph, aliases, direct inheritance, class flags, public member lists, metadata-array projection, direct property-pair findobj filtering, property validation metadata/methods, module-bound validator handles, and dynamic-property defaults. Descriptions remain empty; custom class aliases and InferiorClasses are not populated; GetMethod, SetMethod, and ArgumentValidator.Function reflection is incomplete; recursive handle-graph findobj options, metadata lifecycle events, direct metadata construction, HIR class execution, serialization, and the complete MATLAB metadata surface remain unsupported.

features.feature: Value, handle, and matlab.mixin.Heterogeneous object arrays with shared shape, indexing, mutation, transform, dispatch, and lifetime rules
features.limits: v0.76 covers scalar-fast and nonscalar storage, empty/logical/vector/N-dimensional indexing, transactional assignment and default-filled growth, deletion, concatenation/transforms, value copy-back, handle aliases and explicit lifecycle, property lists, whole-array methods, most-specific heterogeneous classes, display, equality, and guarded VM fallback. Default constructors currently run once per missing element; getDefaultScalarElement, convertObject, ordinary class conversion/dominance, custom indexing/concatenation overrides, automatic destruction, and a stable external object ABI remain open.

features.feature: Representative scalar math, reductions, scans, find, constructors, and array transforms
features.limits: v0.80 migrates representative math, reduction, scan, array-transform, multi-output, and warning-state families to shared descriptors and handlers. This validates the extension framework and cross-tier behavior, not an unbounded MATLAB or toolbox function count.

features.feature: Unified BuiltinRegistry, descriptors, call/result contract, and extension author rules
features.limits: Builtin source contract 1.0 freezes registry, descriptor, call/result, positional input/output constraint, ownership, diagnostic, context, and typed-lowering semantics plus a normalized 118-descriptor default-catalog snapshot. It is a source-integration contract compiled with the engine, not a public C++ binary ABI, arbitrary native callback ABI, or external C adapter. Intrinsics remain explicit engine operations; unsupported catalog entries remain deterministic.

features.feature: Bytecode VM as the production semantic fallback for all legal target-subset code
features.limits: Features marked unsupported elsewhere in this matrix are not legal target-subset code.

features.feature: Guarded portable typed regions with transactional fallback
features.limits: Coverage is intentionally narrower than VM semantics; guard failure must fall back without partial mutation.

features.feature: Bundled SLJIT native scalar/branched/linear-array kernels on x64 and AArch64
features.limits: Native coverage is incremental and never blocks correct VM execution; SIMD and general matrices remain future work.

features.feature: Adaptive tiering, guarded invalidation, process-local native cache, and stateful module sessions
features.limits: RuntimeSessionState persists global and function-persistent bindings independently from adaptive profiling; adaptive reset does not erase it. v0.90 freezes the v1.0 cache as bounded and process-local and stress-tests concurrent compile, lookup, reconfiguration, clear, and accounting. Disk persistence remains additive until atomic storage, bounds, corruption recovery, and complete invalidation are implemented.

features.feature: Compile-once CompiledModule and repeated entry invocation from C++ or a narrow C host
features.limits: v0.90 freezes engine-neutral stateless/persistent compile-once execution through C ABI 1.1, C++ source API 1.0, and machine protocol 1.0 with immutable snapshots, failure/concurrency boundaries, relocatable and unpacked archive consumers, and guarded VM fallback. This supports the declared subset; it does not expose internal RuntimeValue/VM layouts, promise a C++ binary ABI, or imply that every legal script is optimized.

features.feature: Engine-neutral module invocation request/result, staged diagnostics, backend selection, and execution summary
features.limits: The request/result names and behavior, including resource stop fields, are source-level v1.0 API candidates with a protocol-v1 CLI projection. Existing VM-specific invoke APIs remain available. v0.90 freezes their C ABI 1.1 and header-only C++ source API 1.0 projections while explicitly making no public C++ binary-layout promise.

features.feature: Cooperative cancellation plus instruction, wall-time, call-depth, per-value array-payload, and diagnostic execution limits
features.limits: Instruction, deadline, and cancellation controls suppress current typed/native regions and use deterministic VM checkpoints. Call-depth, per-value recursive payload, and diagnostic limits preserve eligible optimized regions. Cancellation is cooperative; noncooperative blocking host code cannot be forcibly interrupted. Array bytes are not an aggregate process-heap/RSS cap, completed side effects are not rolled back, lock-admission wait is outside runtime wall time, the internal source API may throw bad_alloc, and the public C boundary maps it without publishing partial handles.

features.feature: Pure C shared-library ABI candidate with opaque lifetimes, column-major values, diagnostics, sessions, resource controls, and module ownership
features.limits: Frozen v1 candidate ABI major 1 revision 1 exposes copied numeric/logical/UTF-16/Cell/scalar-Struct inputs plus returned objects and function handles. It provides source-graph loading, immutable column-major runtime-owned output views, caller-sized extensible roots, sealed fixed-stride records, v0.86 and v0.90 snapshot compatibility, 64-bit layout checks, module-bound graph synchronization, SOVERSION 1, exact exports, and allocation/internal-failure containment. Borrowed input buffers and an external native callback table are explicitly Post-v1.0.

features.feature: Pure C explicit source graphs and UTF-8 entry/search-path loading with source enumeration and stable load diagnostics
features.limits: In-memory descriptors intentionally carry only names and source text; hosts requiring package, private, path-precedence, or class-folder identity use the filesystem loader. Paths must be valid UTF-8. Source-unit layout is sealed within ABI major 1 because descriptor arrays use a fixed stride.

features.feature: Installable relocatable C and C++20 SDKs with exported CMake API and CLI targets
features.limits: The relocatable package includes the C ABI, header-only C++ source API, CLI, protocol schema, public contract, metadata, examples, documentation, license, and notices. v0.90 emits platform/architecture ZIP or TGZ archives, SHA-256 files, and an unsigned in-toto Statement v1 with SLSA Provenance v1 metadata, then validates C11, multi-TU C++20, and CLI protocol use from an unpacked SDK. Reproducibility covers one fixed compiled payload and statement; cross-build bit reproducibility and authenticated publisher signing or hosted attestation remain release operations.

features.feature: Versioned production CLI, strict option applicability, stable diagnostic mode names, and machine-channel separation
features.limits: CLI contract 1.0 freezes --run, --jit, invocation/source/cache options, machine selection, channel classes, and exits. Repeated single-value options and options in an inapplicable mode are rejected instead of ignored. Historical diagnostic mode names remain supported through v1.x, but their human formatting is not a machine protocol. The undocumented pre-v1 --run-interpreter alias was removed in favor of --run-hir.

features.feature: Versioned one-shot JSON result protocol over engine-neutral module execution
features.limits: Frozen protocol 1.0 covers one-shot production execution, every current RuntimeValue kind, staged diagnostics, complete execution summaries, source-load/CLI/runtime failures, exact uint64 JSON integers, stable exits, a published recursive Draft-7 consumer schema, and exact one-document stdout framing with empty stderr when the stream accepts the complete write. Golden, snapshot, negative, emergency, dynamic CLI, and all four requested-backend documents pass a real vendored schema validator plus exact uint64 semantic checks. Serialization failure uses a static exit-4 request-rejected record; an output-transport failure can still leave stdout missing or partial. Objects remain opaque, retained values require the C API, and this is not a persistent transport protocol.

features.feature: C ABI major/revision policy, caller-sized extensible roots, sealed fixed-stride records, and old-header compatibility
features.limits: Frozen v1 candidate ABI major 1 revision 1 supports append-only root records from revision 1 onward and preserves v0.86 binaries through bounded legacy-prefix initializer writes and a hashed 1.0 snapshot. Source-unit and other array/view records are sealed. Shared-library implementation version 1.1.0 uses SOVERSION/install-name major 1, exact 64-bit layout checks, and an exact 90-symbol manifest. docs/versioning-and-deprecation.md now defines the common v1 compatibility and deprecation policy.

features.feature: Header-only C++20 RAII SDK over the narrow C ABI with installed CMake consumption
features.limits: C++ source API 1.0 covers compile/load/invoke-many, RAII ownership, all current transport values, diagnostics, sessions, cancellation, resource summaries, and documented concurrency without exposing internal C++ layouts. It is header-only over C ABI 1.1, has no C++ binary ABI promise, and is tested from an exact snapshot plus relocated multi-translation-unit consumers.

features.feature: Concurrent embedding lifecycle, module-bound mutable-graph synchronization, exact shared-library exports, and release-platform consumers
features.limits: Pure stateless calls remain concurrent. Requests carrying module-bound graphs serialize per owner, and every session operation from one module conservatively takes the same graph lock before its own session lock. Queue wait is outside runtime wall-time accounting. Host-created arrays remain copy-in with readonly value-owned output spans; external native callback tables and borrowed input buffers are Post-v1.0.

features.feature: Apache-2.0 project licensing, attribution, third-party notices, and installed package metadata
features.limits: MParser first-party source and documentation are licensed under Apache-2.0 with Copyright 2026 Wang Xin. Installed SDKs and release archives carry LICENSE, NOTICE, and third-party notices and expose checked metadata paths through CMake. Vendored components retain their own terms. SHA-256 records and unsigned SLSA provenance provide integrity and audit evidence; authenticated publisher signing or hosted provenance remains a v1.0 publication operation.

features.feature: Frozen public C++ API, narrow C ABI, and versioned machine-readable result protocol
features.limits: The combined v1 candidates now include CLI 1.0, C ABI 1.1 with exact exports/layout and old-header support, header-only C++ source API 1.0 with no binary ABI promise, machine protocol 1.0 with schema/exact framing/uint64/emergency behavior, and builtin source contract 1.0. Public-contract hashes, snapshots, and one shared version/deprecation policy make later changes explicit. Local unsigned provenance is implemented; authenticated publication remains release work.

features.feature: Windows x64, Linux x64, and Linux AArch64 configure/build/test paths
features.limits: CI covers Windows x64, Linux x64, macOS x64, macOS ARM64, and Linux AArch64 native-JIT plus portable fallback. Linux AArch64 remains cross-built and executed under QEMU rather than native hardware.

features.feature: Optimized smoke executables retain executable assertions on MSVC, GCC, and Clang
features.limits: This protects current assert-based tests; new high-risk tests should prefer explicit failure helpers.

features.feature: Versioned parse, compile, process-cold, runtime, allocation, memory, binary-size, and native-cache baseline evidence
features.limits: The non-installed engineering collector emits protocol-1.0 raw timing/allocation samples, source/binary SHA-256 identities, and exact boundaries without machine-specific pass/fail thresholds. Allocation activity is not live heap, peak RSS is process-wide, process-cold is not filesystem-cache-cold, and emulated reports are functional evidence only. Windows native/no-JIT and package evidence passed locally; shared cross-platform and physical-ARM performance evidence remains pending.

features.feature: Task-oriented v1 manuals, human support summary, migration policy, and executable CLI documentation consistency
features.limits: The prose routes users to versioned machine-readable authorities and distinguishes target platforms from current evidence. The documentation smoke derives frozen modes/options from CLI contract 1.0, checks live help, and executes human and JSON production samples. A separate candidate-readiness gate freezes the exact remaining gap set and rejects any open Must-have that implies framework work. Final candidate package confirmation on non-Windows release targets remains part of the shared cross-platform validation window.

features.feature: Machine-validated compatibility claims with executable evidence and explicit gap ownership
features.limits: The matrix is the first audited baseline and must be expanded whenever a milestone changes support claims.

features.feature: Complete MATLAB compatibility, Live Scripts, P-code, MEX, Simulink, graphics, and toolboxes
features.limits: These capabilities are deliberately outside the v1.0 release claim rather than silently treated as incomplete support.

gaps.requirement: Introduce a general root-and-path lvalue contract for nested structure, Cell, array, and value-object copy-back.
gaps.exit_evidence: lvalue_runtime_smoke plus HIR, bytecode, production, and object CLI samples cover mixed paths, rollback, growth, schema extension, and value/handle copy-back.

gaps.requirement: Complete N-by-1 MException stack arrays, nested call frames, cause chains, correction boundary, warning, assert, and stable diagnostic identifiers.
gaps.exit_evidence: exception_runtime_smoke differentially covers full stacks, causes, reports, throw/rethrow/throwAsCaller, warning/lastwarn, assert, and the correction boundary; exception_source_graph_smoke verifies CompiledModule and HIR cross-file stack metadata; the production diagnostics sample proves warning-only success.

gaps.requirement: Close dynamic call/index resolution, feval, str2func, func2str, handle persistence, and shadowing rules.
gaps.exit_evidence: function_handle_runtime_smoke differentially covers HIR and VM closure snapshots, feval/str2func/func2str/functions, multi-output dynamic calls, call/index ambiguity, builtin shadowing, and same-module persistence; function_path_smoke covers literal source-graph dependencies plus path/package/private precedence; all three CLI modes run dynamic_call_demo.m.

gaps.requirement: Separate character arrays from string scalars/arrays and define concatenation, indexing, conversion, and formatting semantics.
gaps.exit_evidence: text_runtime_smoke differentially runs one UTF-16 character/string script through HIR and bytecode, validates supplementary code units, shape, storage, indexing, mutation, implicit expansion, conversions, missing strings, Cell layout, formatting inputs, and the runnable sample; all three public CLI modes report summary 36, and property_validation_smoke covers fixed-shape char/string class properties.

gaps.requirement: Define object arrays, heterogeneous arrays, value copy-back, constructor array behavior, and object lifetime boundaries.
gaps.exit_evidence: object_array_runtime_smoke and object_array_vm_smoke cover physical/logical layout, empty/logical/N-dimensional indexing, repeated assignment, transactional growth and rollback, deletion, transforms, value copy-back, handle aliasing/validity/destruction, property lists, whole-array methods, heterogeneous class resolution/narrowing, and negative class/property cases; bytecode and production CLI gates run object_array_demo.m with summary 14.

gaps.requirement: Freeze the supported meta.* graph, reflection access rules, dynamic dispatch hooks, and explicit unsupported metadata members.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.77.md freezes the supported metadata compatibility table; reflection_contract_smoke covers canonical and legacy type names, nuanced inheritance, inherited/private/static queries, logical-order array projection, direct property-pair metadata and handle findobj filters, PropertyValidation methods and callable module-bound validator handles, dynamic-property defaults, string metaclass lookup, and explicit unsupported-field diagnostics; bytecode and production CLI gates run reflection_contract_demo.m with summary 22.

gaps.requirement: Define global and function-persistent declaration, storage, assignment, lifetime, clearing, embedding, concurrency, and optimization-fallback boundaries.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.78.md defines the supported contract; parser_smoke, semantic_smoke, bytecode_smoke, bytecode_region_smoke, and runtime_session_smoke cover syntax through shared execution, every supported write route, isolated and injected state, targeted clearing, reset, adaptive reuse, and compiled-artifact lifetime; all three public CLI modes run workspace_session_demo.m with summary 14389.

gaps.requirement: Freeze RuntimeValue ownership, shape, indexing, object, exception, call-frame, and output-arity contracts before registry migration.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.79.md and architecture.md define the internal freeze. runtime_contract_smoke covers factories, normalized payload/shape invariants, malformed values, deep value copies, shared handle aliases and cycles, function-handle identity, storable transport values, shared call frames, every fallback name, and 2,048 invocations of one compiled persistent multi-output function. Region, typed, and adaptive tests assert structured fallback propagation, and all three CLI modes run runtime_contract_demo.m with summary 11023. Remaining target-subset and release gaps are additive or contract extensions rather than known replacements of the main IR or VM.

gaps.requirement: Land BuiltinRegistry, descriptors, shared call/result/error contract, extension levels, and representative family migration.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.80.md and docs/extending-builtins.md define the source contract and three extension levels. builtin_registry_smoke covers the frozen 118-name catalog, metadata, custom names and aliases, duplicate/freeze/context/exception/output boundaries, local shadowing, builtin handles, HIR/VM parity, portable typed execution, and native SLJIT when available. All three public CLI modes run builtin_registry_demo.m with summary 510446, and the focused AArch64 native/portable jobs execute the same evidence.

gaps.requirement: Separate host-facing compile/invoke status, diagnostics, backend selection, outputs, workspace, and execution summaries from BytecodeVmOptions and BytecodeVmResult.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.81.md defines the source contract. module_execution_smoke covers cached bytecode/portable/native/automatic execution, multi-output, profiling, compilation/validation/warning/runtime diagnostics, malformed values, workspace transport, source projection, session persistence, and reset. embedding_execution_demo_smoke runs a compile-once C++ host sample with summary 5075 in native and portable platform jobs.

gaps.requirement: Freeze compile/load/invoke-many C++ API, narrow C ABI, value ownership, diagnostics, lifecycle, and versioned machine protocol.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.90.md and docs/public-contract-v1.json freeze C ABI 1.1, header-only C++ source API 1.0, and machine protocol 1.0. public_contract_smoke locks live headers, snapshots, exports, schema, and golden hashes; old v0.86 and current v0.90 C consumers, a C++ 1.0 snapshot consumer, 64-bit layout checks, exact exports, machine reference-consumer negatives, deterministic failure tests, relocated/unpacked SDK consumers, and release-platform CI enforce the combined boundary.

gaps.requirement: Expose copied multi-source and shared UTF-8 filesystem source-graph compilation through the narrow C ABI without leaking SourceUnit internals.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.84.md and docs/embedding-c-api.md define the contract. c_api_smoke covers descriptor versioning, owned source buffers, cross-source diagnostics, source enumeration, package/class-folder loading, invalid options, and stable load failures. c_api_utf8_source_graph_smoke proves non-ASCII entry/search paths and retained source names. c_source_graph_demo_smoke runs the real +folderpkg/@Counter graph, and both focused AArch64 jobs include the C evidence.

gaps.requirement: Install a relocatable pure C SDK and CLI package that an isolated external C11 project can discover, link, deploy, and execute.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.85.md and docs/embedding-c-api.md define the package contract. installed_c_consumer_smoke installs, relocates, and consumes MParser through exported CMake targets on Windows x64 and Linux x64. Focused AArch64 CI independently installs, cross-builds, and runs native-JIT and portable C consumers plus installed CLIs under QEMU.

gaps.requirement: Define a versioned one-shot machine result protocol over the engine-neutral execution result with stable values, diagnostics, summaries, channels, and process exits.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.86.md and docs/machine-result-protocol.md define protocol major 1. machine_protocol_smoke locks every RuntimeValue kind, column-major projection, non-finite values, UTF handling, diagnostic trees, and execution fields against a golden document. machine_protocol_cli_smoke parses success, compilation, validation, runtime, source-load, and CLI failures while asserting stdout/stderr and exit contracts; machine_protocol_production_cli_smoke supplies direct cross-emulator evidence.

gaps.requirement: Define and prove additive C ABI evolution without allowing future structure growth to overwrite old host objects or corrupt fixed-stride descriptor arrays.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.87.md and docs/c-abi-compatibility.md define ABI major 1 revision 1. c_api_smoke proves fixed old writes, sized full-storage initialization, oversized invocation/load/summary behavior, rejection contracts, and sealed source units. c_api_v1_compat_smoke compiles only against the frozen v0.86 header snapshot. c_abi_compat_demo_smoke and relocated installed consumers validate the revision-1 interface, including focused native/portable AArch64 QEMU execution.

gaps.requirement: Install a public C++20 RAII facade over the narrow C ABI without exposing internal compiler, RuntimeValue, or VM layouts.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.88.md and docs/embedding-cpp-api.md define ownership, failure, value, invocation, session, cancellation, and resource-summary contracts. cpp_api_smoke covers the complete facade plus UTF-8 source graphs, cpp_embedding_demo_smoke is runnable, installed_cpp_consumer_smoke relocates and consumes only MParser::cpp_api, and focused native/portable AArch64 jobs cross-build and execute the installed consumer under QEMU.

gaps.requirement: Add cancellation and limits for instructions, time, call depth, array bytes, diagnostics, and host exception containment.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.82.md defines zero-as-unlimited request controls, cooperative cancellation, stable uncatchable stops, per-value payload semantics, JIT suppression, non-rollback, and builtin cooperation. module_resource_control_smoke proves exact instruction and call-depth termination, live cross-thread cancellation, wall-time stop, input/runtime payload limits, diagnostic truncation, session reuse, optimized fallback policy, host exception containment, and deliberate bad_alloc propagation. embedding_resource_control_demo_smoke runs the deterministic host sample in focused native and portable AArch64 jobs.

gaps.requirement: Add macOS x64/ARM64 build, test, install, and consumer evidence to the release platform matrix.
gaps.exit_evidence: The macos-15-intel x64 and macos-15 ARM64 jobs build and run the full native-SLJIT suite, create and relocate BUILD_TESTING=OFF installs, configure independent C11 and C++20 consumers, execute both SDKs, and check installed binary architecture and version. Windows x64, Linux x64, and Linux AArch64 native/portable jobs remain in the same matrix.

gaps.requirement: Define and prove public embedding concurrency, handle lifetime, repeated load/unload, and shared-library export/version boundaries.
gaps.exit_evidence: docs/v0.89.md and both embedding guides define the contract. c_api_lifecycle_stress performs concurrent retain/release and retained-owner probes; cpp_api_concurrency_stress covers pure calls, exact shared-handle mutation, sessions, cancellation, and isolated budgets; embedding_unload_stress performs 256 load/query/unload cycles; c_api_shared_library_abi checks the exact 90-symbol manifest and SOVERSION/install-name major 1.

gaps.requirement: Select and add an explicit project distribution license before publishing release archives or v1.0.
gaps.exit_evidence: The project owner selected Apache-2.0 with Copyright 2026 Wang Xin. project_license_smoke locks the official license SHA-256 and required project/SLJIT notices. CMake exports the SPDX identifier/copyright plus checked file paths, and both relocated installed consumers require those artifacts and metadata.

gaps.requirement: Produce checksummed platform/architecture archives and prove the unpacked SDK rather than relying only on source-tree installs.
gaps.exit_evidence: mparser_release_package emits ZIP/TGZ plus SHA-256 files and a validated unsigned SLSA Provenance v1 statement. release_archive_smoke packages one fixed payload twice with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, checks identical archive/provenance hashes and safe single-root paths, unpacks the archive, builds independent C11 and multi-TU C++20 consumers, and runs the installed json-v1 CLI without source-tree or loader-path access. Final cross-platform archives and authenticated publisher signing or hosted attestation remain v1.0 publication operations.

gaps.requirement: Bind every release archive to source, public contracts, build parameters, platform/toolchain, and a documented builder identity, then authenticate the published artifact through signing or hosted provenance.
gaps.exit_evidence: The local CMake/CPack builder emits and semantically validates a deterministic unsigned in-toto Statement v1 with the SLSA Provenance v1 predicate, requires clean source for publication targets, binds archive plus statement in SHA256SUMS, and rejects independently modified archive content or statement authentication metadata.
